title: Board task
description: Durable state of one task on a project's board (ctx.board, design/board.md): work that outlives a run. Only the work state machine moves it, and each move names the decision behind it (INV-13). Mutable state that points at immutable artifacts. @1.1 adds a spent budget's funding: the lines a budget-spent wait asks for (`waiting.funding`), and the raises an approved request applied (`funding`). 1.2 adds the `defect` link: the done task this one fixes a defect of, and the landing sha of its change.

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria, each checked before the task is done.

dependsOn.description: Tasks of the same project that must be done first.

actionClass.description: What running the task does, as the autonomy policy classifies it; it decides whether starting it needs a person.

writes.description: The subject the task writes; one task holds write authority over it at a time (INV-15).

budget.description: The most the task's attempts may draw from each pool, together, as the resource ledger counts them for the task; a line reached blocks the task (budget-spent, INV-9). An approved funding request raises it (`funding`).

state.description: Active: ready, claimed, running, review. Interrupted: waiting-for-input, waiting-for-approval. Terminal: done, cancelled. proposed waits for its dependencies and the policy.

holder.description: The lease on the task (resource board-task:<taskId>); a write presents its generation as a fence (INV-4, INV-15).

run.description: The run of the current attempt. Recorded before the run starts, so a restart reconciles it and never starts it again (INV-4).

result.description: What the attempt produced, recorded when it enters review, with the exact subject it leaves (a commit, or the result artifact for work with no repository).

subject.description: The exact subject after the attempt, e.g. the worktree's commit.

files.description: Paths touched, relative to the workspace.

acceptance.description: The `acceptance` decision on the result; required to be done.

next.description: A proposed next task, in words.

waiting.description: Why an interrupted task waits, or a review the board holds for the operator, and until when. On expiry it never runs: an approval wait is rejected (fail closed), an input wait cancels the task, a review held for the operator ends review-expired.

reason.description: approval-needed: the policy asks before starting; budget-spent: an attempt spent its budget; reconciliation-failed: a started run could not be reconciled, so running it again needs approval; retries-spent: review rejected the last attempt allowed; question: the lead or operator must answer; rejected: an approval was refused or expired, or none could be asked (a spent budget or a lost run under a policy verdict other than ask); review-expired: no acceptance decision came before the reviewer's lease lapsed, or before a review held for the operator expired; operator-review: in review, only the operator's acceptance accepts the result now (a required check not passed, or the class forbidden), so the board holds the review for the operator, bounded by the policy's wait for the class; landing (1.3, T293): in review, an accepted writing result waits for its landing, done only once its merge request is merged or its landing finds no change to land, bounded at 14 days.

pendingChecks.description: For operator-review: the class's required checks the acceptance did not report passed. board-task@1.4 adds `red-on-base` (T306c, ADR-0079).

funding.description: @1.1, for budget-spent: the lines the funding request asks to add to the budget, at most one per pool and unit of it. The request's subject version is `budget-spent:<sha256 of their canonical JSON>`, so its verdict binds to exactly these.

@1.1: each raise of `budget` an approved funding request applied, oldest first: the lines added, the operator's `approval` artifact, and the board's decision that applied them. One per attempt at most, so bounded by `attempts.max`.

defect.description: 1.2: the defect this task fixes: `fixes` is the done task whose landed change held it, `sha` the landing sha of that change (7 to 64 hex characters), `at` when the link was set, `by` who set it (`filed`: when the task was filed). `system metrics` counts the tasks fixed as escaped defects.

reason.description: forbidden: the policy forbids its action; dependency-cancelled: a task it depends on was cancelled.

lastDecision.description: Decision artifact that caused the latest state transition (INV-13).

allOf.description: Only a claimed, running, or reviewed task holds a lease; a review the board holds for the operator holds none.
Done needs the run that produced it, the result with its subject, and an accepted acceptance decision.
@1.1: a funding ask is a budget-spent wait's, and a record that carries an ask or a raise is @1.1, so a reader on @1.0 never meets one.
1.2: a record that carries a defect link is board-task@1.2 (or later).
1.3 (T293): a task that waits for its landing is board-task@1.3, its result accepted (result.acceptance).
